steps.title: 閉合回用水流程
steps.titleEn: Close the reclaimed-water loop
steps.objective: 區分已處理用水、再生水與最終使用。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish treated used water, reclaimed product and final use.
steps.instruction: 畫出已處理用水→MF/UF→RO→UV的概念流程，另分工業專管與水庫→淨水場→自來水兩條用途支路。標示這是一般教學路線，MBR等實廠配置可能不同。
steps.instructionEn: Draw treated used water to MF/UF, RO and UV. Add industrial dedicated supply and reservoir-to-waterworks-to-taps branches. Label this a general teaching route; actual configurations such as MBR may differ.
steps.observation: 確認原污水並未直接接入再生水產品端，間接飲用支路也沒有略過淨水場。
steps.observationEn: Confirm raw sewage is not connected directly to product and the indirect-potable branch does not omit waterworks.
steps.failure: 把NEWater等同未處理污水，或把間接飲用畫成直接供水。
steps.failureEn: Equating NEWater with untreated sewage or drawing indirect reuse as direct tap supply.
steps.check: 每個水質邊界都有名稱，兩條使用支路可獨立追蹤。
steps.checkEn: Name each water-quality boundary and make both use branches traceable.

knowledge.title: 水質邊界
knowledge.text: 已處理用水仍需後續純化；不同水流名稱代表不同處理狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Treated used water still requires further purification; stream names indicate different treatment states.

knowledge.title: 用途路徑
knowledge.text: 工業供水與間接飲用回用有不同的下游系統介面。
knowledge.textEn: Industrial supply and indirect potable reuse connect to different downstream systems.

options: 淨水場再處理後才供應自來水
直接跳過任何後續處理
改由工業專管自動變成家戶管線
optionsEn: Waterworks treatment before tap-water supply
Bypass all subsequent treatment
Automatically turn an industrial main into household supply
quiz.question: 在PUB描述的間接飲用路徑中，水庫之後還有什麼？
quiz.questionEn: In PUB’s described indirect-potable route, what follows the reservoir?
quiz.explanation: 「間接」包含水庫混合與後續淨水處理，不能刪除。
quiz.explanationEn: Indirect reuse includes reservoir blending and subsequent waterworks treatment.

steps.title: 建立進流水的資料邊界
steps.titleEn: Define the feedwater data boundary
steps.objective: 把上游處理狀態與下游膜系統需求對齊。
steps.objectiveEn: Match upstream treatment status with downstream membrane evidence needs.
steps.instruction: 自設一張進流水紀錄表，分別列流量、混濁、溶解物及微生物資料欄。對缺少數據的欄位保留未知，說明它可能影響哪一道後續屏障。
steps.instructionEn: Create a feedwater-record template for flow, turbidity, dissolved substances and microbiological evidence. Keep missing fields unknown and identify the downstream barrier each may affect.
steps.observation: 比較水看起來透明與已取得化學或微生物證據的差別。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish visual clarity from chemical or microbiological evidence.
steps.failure: 以肉眼清澈取代進流水品質與處理狀態確認。
steps.failureEn: Substituting visual clarity for feed-quality and treatment-status verification.
steps.check: 至少四個資料欄各連到一項後續功能或驗證需求。
steps.checkEn: Link at least four fields to a downstream function or verification need.

knowledge.title: 污染物類別
knowledge.text: 粒子、溶解成分與微生物需要不同的量測與處理觀點。
knowledge.textEn: Particles, dissolved constituents and microorganisms require different measurement and treatment perspectives.

knowledge.title: 上游依賴
knowledge.text: 後段設備的表現受進流水條件影響，不能只看設備名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Downstream performance depends on feed conditions, not just equipment names.

options: 透明等於所有溶解物已去除
外觀已觀察，化學條件仍未知
可用出水流量代替化學資料
optionsEn: Clarity means all dissolved substances are removed
Appearance observed; chemical conditions unknown
Product flow can replace chemical data
quiz.question: 進流水透明但化學資料缺漏，最適合的記錄是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Feedwater looks clear but chemical data is missing. What should be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 外觀只能描述有限性質，不能補出未量測的污染物資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Appearance describes limited properties and cannot supply missing contaminant measurements.

steps.title: 分辨MF/UF與RO的任務
steps.titleEn: Distinguish MF/UF and RO roles
steps.objective: 用污染物類型理解不同膜屏障的互補。
steps.objectiveEn: Use contaminant classes to understand complementary membrane barriers.
steps.instruction: 畫三類符號代表粒子、微生物與溶解離子，將MF/UF與RO畫成不同功能方塊。用「可能被截留／仍需下段處理／需量測確認」標記，不填通用百分之百去除承諾。
steps.instructionEn: Represent particles, microorganisms and dissolved ions with symbols, and draw separate MF/UF and RO blocks. Label retained, requiring downstream treatment and needing measurement without universal 100-percent removal claims.
steps.observation: 注意前段粒子控制可改善後段條件，但不是所有溶解物的證明。
steps.observationEn: Particle control upstream can improve downstream conditions without proving removal of every dissolved constituent.
steps.failure: 把所有膜都當成同一種細篩，認為第一道即可取代全部後段。
steps.failureEn: Treating all membranes as the same fine sieve and assuming the first replaces every later barrier.
steps.check: 三類符號均有去向與未確認項，且MF/UF和RO功能可區分。
steps.checkEn: Give each symbol a destination and unresolved point, with distinguishable MF/UF and RO roles.

knowledge.title: 互補屏障
knowledge.text: 不同單元針對不同性質的污染物，串接可處理不同風險。
knowledge.textEn: Different units address different contaminant properties; a train combines complementary functions.

knowledge.title: 簡化限制
knowledge.text: 圖上符號只教分類，不代表特定膜在所有條件下的截留率。
knowledge.textEn: Diagram symbols teach categories, not rejection rates of a particular membrane under all conditions.

options: 所有溶解鹽類都已移除
後段RO和UV永遠可以取消
該量測條件下粒子相關指標較低
optionsEn: All dissolved salts have been removed
RO and UV can always be omitted
A low particle-related indicator under those measurement conditions
quiz.question: MF/UF出水低濁度能單獨證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does low MF/UF product turbidity establish on its own?
quiz.explanation: 低濁度不是所有化學與微生物條件的完整證明。
quiz.explanationEn: Low turbidity is not complete evidence of every chemical and microbiological condition.

steps.title: 檢查第一道膜屏障的完整性
steps.titleEn: Review first-barrier integrity evidence
steps.objective: 辨認產水量與膜屏障完整性不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish water production from membrane-barrier integrity.
steps.instruction: 自繪膜模組及密封介面，標出穿膜與繞過密封的兩種可能路徑。建立完整性證據、出水觀察與設備狀態三欄，所有數據留作自設教學示例。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a membrane module and seals, marking passage through the membrane and possible seal bypass. Create integrity-evidence, product-observation and equipment-state columns using only labeled example data.
steps.observation: 觀察出水量正常是否仍可能有旁通或局部缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Consider whether normal product flow can coexist with bypass or a local defect.
steps.failure: 以流量正常或馬達運轉，替代屏障完整性證據。
steps.failureEn: Using normal flow or a running motor as proof of barrier integrity.
steps.check: 列出兩種缺陷假說及能區分它們的觀察，不能只寫「正常」。
steps.checkEn: List two defect hypotheses and observations distinguishing them rather than simply writing normal.

knowledge.title: 完整性與通量
knowledge.text: 流得過去說明有產水，不等於水只經過預期的屏障。
knowledge.textEn: Flow establishes production, not that all water passed through the intended barrier.

knowledge.title: 繞流介面
knowledge.text: 接合或密封也屬屏障的一部分，不能只檢查膜材料。
knowledge.textEn: Joints and seals are part of the barrier, not just the membrane material.

options: 產量有證據，屏障完整性尚未驗證
產量正常已足以證明完整性
可直接視為所有污染物都不存在
optionsEn: Production evidenced; barrier integrity unverified
Normal production proves integrity
All contaminants can be considered absent
quiz.question: 流量正常但完整性證據不明，應如何分類？
quiz.questionEn: Flow is normal but integrity evidence is unclear. How should the result be classified?
quiz.explanation: 功能宣稱需要對應證據，產量不能替代完整性。
quiz.explanationEn: Functional claims need matching evidence; output quantity cannot substitute for integrity.

stages.title: 回用水邊界與前處理
stages.description: 辨認進流水、不同污染物與第一道膜屏障的證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Identify feedwater, contaminant classes and evidence for the first membrane barrier.

steps.title: 閉合RO三股水的物料平衡
steps.titleEn: Balance the three RO streams
steps.objective: 區分進水、透過水與濃縮水的數量。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish feed, permeate and concentrate quantities.
steps.instruction: 用自設且標明假想的單位流量，畫進水分成透過水和濃縮水。先檢查水量加總，再比較溶質去向，不把濃縮水當作消失或無污染的水。
steps.instructionEn: Use explicitly invented unit flows to split feed into permeate and concentrate. Check the water balance, then trace solutes without treating concentrate as vanished or contaminant-free.
steps.observation: 觀察透過水比例提高時，濃縮側需要重新檢查哪些假設。
steps.observationEn: Consider which concentrate-side assumptions need review as the permeate fraction rises.
steps.failure: 只報告產水量，遺漏濃縮水量及所攜帶的物質。
steps.failureEn: Reporting product flow without concentrate flow or transported substances.
steps.check: 水量收支閉合，並標記尚未納入的溶質與實際設備限制。
steps.checkEn: Close the water balance and identify unmodeled solutes and actual equipment limits.

knowledge.title: 分離不是消滅
knowledge.text: 膜分離改變物質分配，並不使被排除的物質憑空消失。
knowledge.textEn: Membrane separation redistributes substances rather than making rejected material disappear.

knowledge.title: 比例與條件
knowledge.text: 水量回收比例只描述部分績效，須與品質和濃縮側條件一起看。
knowledge.textEn: Water recovery describes only part of performance and must be considered with quality and concentrate conditions.

options: 75單位，因與產水相同
25單位
0單位，因被膜去除
optionsEn: 75 units, because it equals product flow
25 units
0 units, because the membrane removes it
quiz.question: 假想進水100單位、透過水75單位，在忽略蓄積下濃縮水多少？
quiz.questionEn: For invented feed of 100 units and permeate of 75, with no storage, what is concentrate flow?
quiz.explanation: 水量守恆給出100−75＝25；這只是教學收支，未代表可用操作比例。
quiz.explanationEn: Conservation gives 100−75=25; this teaching balance does not define an operating recovery.

steps.title: 解讀導電度而不過度推論
steps.titleEn: Interpret conductivity without overclaiming
steps.objective: 區分離子相關指標與完整水質。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish an ion-related indicator from complete water quality.
steps.instruction: 閱讀PUB水質表的導電度、濁度和有機碳欄位，分開記下單位與描述性質。自設兩份導電度相近但其他欄位不同的示例，比較可以及不可以下的結論。
steps.instructionEn: Read conductivity, turbidity and organic-carbon fields in PUB’s table, recording units and properties separately. Invent two samples with similar conductivity but differing other fields and compare valid and invalid conclusions.
steps.observation: 注意單一低讀值不能補出未測項目。
steps.observationEn: A single low reading cannot supply unmeasured parameters.
steps.failure: 用低導電度直接證明無微生物或所有有機污染物。
steps.failureEn: Using low conductivity as proof of no microorganisms or all organic contaminants.
steps.check: 為三個指標各寫出一項能回答與不能回答的問題。
steps.checkEn: For each indicator, state one question it can and cannot answer.

knowledge.title: 代理指標
knowledge.text: 導電度反映水中導電性成分的綜合影響，不是每種污染物的直接濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Conductivity reflects combined conductive constituents, not direct concentration of every contaminant.

knowledge.title: 單位語意
knowledge.text: 不同量測單位代表不同性質，不能因數字小就彼此比較優劣。
knowledge.textEn: Different units describe different properties; small numbers cannot be compared indiscriminately.

options: 低導電度證明微生物為零
可把導電度單位換成菌落數
離子相關指標已有資料，微生物狀態仍待驗證
optionsEn: Low conductivity proves zero microorganisms
Conductivity units can be relabeled as colony counts
Ion-related evidence exists; microbial status remains unverified
quiz.question: 導電度很低而微生物結果尚未取得，最合理的結論是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Conductivity is low but microbiological results are unavailable. What follows?
quiz.explanation: 不同指標不能互相替代，尤其不能把物理電性當成微生物檢驗。
quiz.explanationEn: Indicators are not interchangeable, particularly electrical properties and microbial testing.

steps.title: 診斷膜效能趨勢
steps.titleEn: Diagnose membrane-performance trends
steps.objective: 在比較膜效能前檢查進水與量測條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Check feed and measurement conditions before comparing membrane performance.
steps.instruction: 自行建立兩段時間的流量、壓差、溫度與進水品質示例。先標記條件差異，再為產水下降列出積垢、進水變化與儀器偏差等假說，不指定清洗藥劑。
steps.instructionEn: Create example flow, differential pressure, temperature and feed-quality records for two periods. Mark condition changes before considering fouling, changed feed or instrument bias for lower output; prescribe no cleaning chemicals.
steps.observation: 比較是否在相近條件下仍有持續偏差。
steps.observationEn: Check whether persistent differences remain under comparable conditions.
steps.failure: 只用產量降低就斷定膜已損壞，忽略溫度、進水與量測。
steps.failureEn: Declaring membrane damage from lower output alone while ignoring temperature, feed and measurements.
steps.check: 至少保留三種原因與一項可區分它們的補充資料。
steps.checkEn: Retain three candidate causes and a discriminating additional observation.

knowledge.title: 條件化趨勢
knowledge.text: 性能比較需保留進水與環境條件，避免把條件變化當設備退化。
knowledge.textEn: Performance comparisons require feed and environmental context to distinguish condition changes from deterioration.

knowledge.title: 診斷而非猜測
knowledge.text: 同一現象可能有多因；查證計畫應讓假說可被反駁。
knowledge.textEn: One symptom can have multiple causes; investigation should make hypotheses testable.

options: 核對比較條件與量測，再評估設備趨勢
直接認定膜完整性破壞
刪除溫度資料以保持表格簡單
optionsEn: Reconcile conditions and measurements before judging equipment trends
Immediately conclude loss of membrane integrity
Delete temperature to simplify the table
quiz.question: 兩次產水量不同，但進水溫度也不同，應先做什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Product flow differs between periods with different feed temperatures. What comes first?
quiz.explanation: 先控制比較範圍，才能讓效能趨勢具有可解釋性。
quiz.explanationEn: Establishing comparable conditions makes performance trends interpretable.

steps.title: 辨認UV屏障與驗證量
steps.titleEn: Identify the UV barrier and its evidence
steps.objective: 說明消毒與物質分離的不同任務。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the different tasks of disinfection and separation.
steps.instruction: 在RO後方加入UV功能方塊，分別記錄光源狀態、水流與水的透光相關證據。畫出「燈亮但驗證不完整」情境，不自行提供飲用水消毒劑量。
steps.instructionEn: Add a UV block after RO, separating light-source state, flow and transmission-related evidence. Illustrate a lamp-on-but-unverified case without specifying drinking-water disinfection doses.
steps.observation: 觀察光源通電是否能直接證明所有水得到足夠作用。
steps.observationEn: Ask whether an energized source proves adequate treatment of all passing water.
steps.failure: 把燈亮等同消毒已驗證，或認為UV會把溶解鹽類分走。
steps.failureEn: Equating a lit lamp with verified disinfection or assuming UV separates dissolved salts.
steps.check: 用不同證據欄位分開設備狀態、處理條件與水質驗證。
steps.checkEn: Separate equipment state, treatment conditions and quality verification in the record.

knowledge.title: 功能差異
knowledge.text: UV作用於微生物失活；它不是RO式的溶質分流。
knowledge.textEn: UV targets microbial inactivation rather than RO-like solute separation.

knowledge.title: 完整作用條件
knowledge.text: 光源、流動與水的光學條件共同影響處理，不能只看開關。
knowledge.textEn: Source, flow and optical conditions jointly affect treatment; an on/off signal is insufficient.

options: 出水所有化學成分均已去除
設備有開啟指示，處理效果仍需對應證據
全部水質項目已通過檢驗
optionsEn: Every chemical constituent has been removed
An on indication exists; treatment performance still needs evidence
All water-quality parameters have passed
quiz.question: UV燈顯示開啟，可直接證明哪項？
quiz.questionEn: A UV lamp indicates on. What does that directly prove?
quiz.explanation: 設備狀態不是完整水質結果，必須保留各自的驗證。
quiz.explanationEn: Equipment state is not a complete quality result; each requires its own verification.

stages.title: 分離、診斷與消毒
stages.description: 把逆滲透的水量與水質、膜狀態及UV功能分開判讀。
stages.descriptionEn: Interpret RO flow and quality, membrane condition and UV function separately.

steps.title: 建立採樣追溯鏈
steps.titleEn: Establish sample traceability
steps.objective: 讓結果對應到正確位置、時間與樣品。
steps.objectiveEn: Link results to the correct location, time and sample.
steps.instruction: 設計樣品表單，包含編號、取樣位置、時間、分析項目、方法和結果狀態。用兩個假想相近編號，演練如何辨認進水樣被誤標為出水樣。
steps.instructionEn: Design a sample form with ID, location, time, analyte, method and result state. Use two similar invented IDs to detect feedwater mislabeled as product.
steps.observation: 檢查只有檢驗數字、沒有樣品身分時是否仍能解讀。
steps.observationEn: Assess whether a result remains interpretable without sample identity.
steps.failure: 將不同時間、位置或方法的結果拼成同一批水的證明。
steps.failureEn: Combining results from different times, locations or methods as proof about one water batch.
steps.check: 每筆示例結果可反查完整身分，錯置樣品須保留更正紀錄。
steps.checkEn: Trace each example result to its identity and retain correction records for mislabeling.

knowledge.title: 代表性
knowledge.text: 樣品能代表的水流與時間範圍，取決於採樣設計及紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: The stream and time represented by a sample depend on sampling design and records.

knowledge.title: 結果狀態
knowledge.text: 待分析、低於檢出能力及未檢測是不同狀態，不應都填成零。
knowledge.textEn: Pending, below detection capability and not tested are different states and should not all become zero.

options: 0，表示沒有檢出
以另一位置的結果自動補入
未檢測，保留待取得證據
optionsEn: Zero, meaning not detected
Automatically fill with a result from another location
Not tested; evidence pending
quiz.question: 某項分析尚未執行，表格應怎麼填？
quiz.questionEn: How should an analysis that has not been performed be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 未檢測並不等於未檢出；誠實的狀態是追溯鏈的一部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Not tested is not equivalent to not detected; accurate status is part of traceability.

steps.title: 核對工業與間接回用介面
steps.titleEn: Review industrial and indirect-reuse interfaces
steps.objective: 把目的地要求連到對應供水路徑。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect destination requirements to the appropriate supply route.
steps.instruction: 建立兩欄：工業專管與水庫後接淨水場。為兩欄分別列交付點、後續處理與需確認的品質責任；不把工業廠內額外純化假定為PUB已完成。
steps.instructionEn: Compare dedicated industrial supply with reservoir-to-waterworks reuse. List handover point, further treatment and quality responsibility, without assuming PUB performs every customer’s additional purification.
steps.observation: 觀察相同再生水來源在不同使用者端是否仍有不同後續需求。
steps.observationEn: The same reclaimed source may face different downstream needs at different users.
steps.failure: 把NEWater典型值直接視為每一家工業製程的完整規格。
steps.failureEn: Treating NEWater typical values as complete specifications for every industrial process.
steps.check: 兩條路徑各保留一項使用端需另行確認的介面條件。
steps.checkEn: Retain one destination-specific condition requiring separate confirmation for each route.

knowledge.title: 適用途徑
knowledge.text: 水的目的地與後續處理會影響應驗證的介面，不能只看名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Destination and subsequent treatment influence the interface to verify, not just the water’s name.

knowledge.title: 交付邊界
knowledge.text: 公用供水與客戶製程之間的品質責任須明確，不能隱含轉移。
knowledge.textEn: Quality responsibilities between utility supply and customer processes must be explicit.

options: 在客戶端增加明確的處理與驗證邊界
將供水典型值改成客戶所有需求
假定所有再生水用途完全相同
optionsEn: Add an explicit customer treatment and verification boundary
Relabel typical supply values as all customer requirements
Assume every reuse application is identical
quiz.question: 某晶圓廠需要額外純化，合理的模型表示是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: A wafer fab requires further purification. How should the model show it?

quiz.explanationEn: Utility supply and downstream process needs are different boundaries that must be stated separately.

steps.title: 記錄異常與未驗證狀態
steps.titleEn: Record anomalies and unverified states
steps.objective: 避免在證據矛盾時給出過度的品質結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid overclaiming quality when evidence conflicts.
steps.instruction: 自行寫一個導電度趨勢改變但重測尚未完成的案例。列出感測器、取樣身分、進水條件與處理狀態的核對清單，交付狀態標成待驗證，不作真實放水指令。
steps.instructionEn: Invent a changed conductivity trend with repeat analysis pending. List sensor, sample identity, feed and treatment checks; label the learning handover unverified without issuing actual release commands.
steps.observation: 注意一次正常重測是否足以解釋先前異常與整段時間。
steps.observationEn: Consider whether one normal repeat explains the prior anomaly and the entire affected period.
steps.failure: 只留下正常讀值、刪除異常資料，造成虛假的連續合格紀錄。
steps.failureEn: Keeping normal readings while deleting anomalies to create a falsely continuous acceptable record.
steps.check: 保留事件時間線、原始異常與待取得資料，結論不得超出觀察期間。
steps.checkEn: Preserve the timeline, original anomaly and missing evidence; limit conclusions to observed periods.

knowledge.title: 偏差追查
knowledge.text: 異常應有可追溯的查證與結案理由，不能只靠後續正常值覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Anomalies need traceable investigation and closure reasons rather than being overwritten by later normal values.

knowledge.title: 時間範圍
knowledge.text: 採樣結果有其時間與位置範圍，不自動涵蓋未觀測時段。
knowledge.textEn: Sample results have time and location scope and do not automatically cover unobserved periods.

options: 直接刪除，僅保留最後結果
保留並查明適用範圍與原因
用兩次平均值宣告整段正常
optionsEn: Delete it and retain only the latest result
Preserve it and investigate its scope and cause
Average the two and declare the entire interval normal

quiz.questionEn: A later sample is normal. What should happen to the earlier anomaly?
quiz.explanation: 後續結果不會自動解釋前次異常或填補時間空白。
quiz.explanationEn: A later result does not automatically explain an earlier anomaly or fill a time gap.

steps.objective: 區分典型資料、操作準則與產品驗證證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish typical data, operating criteria and product-verification evidence.
steps.instruction: 整理流程、物料平衡、屏障狀態、採樣紀錄與目的地介面。閱讀PUB典型值表的欄名及日期，為每個課程結論標上来源或自設假設，不把典型值轉成自行放行標準。
steps.instructionEn: Organize process, balance, barrier, sampling and destination records. Read the headings and date of PUB’s typical-values table; label sources or invented assumptions without converting typical values into self-authorized release criteria.

steps.observationEn: Check whether typical, guideline and current measurement are being conflated.
steps.failure: 拿公開典型值表代替當批水的實測與完整驗證。
steps.failureEn: Substituting a public typical-values table for measurements and verification of a specific batch.
steps.check: 交付三類資料的區分表及至少四項可追溯證據，明示這不是飲水安全認證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a distinction table and at least four traceable evidence items, explicitly identifying this as no drinking-water safety certification.

knowledge.title: 資料類別
knowledge.text: 典型值描述通常表現；指引、操作判準與特定樣品結果有不同角色。
knowledge.textEn: Typical values describe usual performance; guidelines, operating criteria and sample results have distinct roles.

knowledge.title: 多重證據
knowledge.text: 屏障、監測、採樣與目的地需求需相互吻合，單一指標無法概括。
knowledge.textEn: Barriers, monitoring, sampling and destination requirements must agree; one indicator cannot represent them all.

options: 使用者自行處理的水已通過全部驗證
任何實廠都可照表自行設定放行門檻
官方描述的通常水質表現與資料範圍
optionsEn: User-treated water has passed all verification
Every plant may adopt the table as release settings
The authority’s described usual quality and data scope
quiz.question: 一張標示「典型值」的官方表格能直接證明哪件事？
quiz.questionEn: What does an official table labeled typical values directly establish?
quiz.explanation: 公開典型資料是背景證據，不是特定樣品、設備或操作授權。
quiz.explanationEn: Public typical data is background evidence, not verification or authorization for a particular sample, device or operation.

steps.title: 二級處理出水採樣站：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Secondary-effluent sampling station: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 二級處理出水採樣站：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Secondary-effluent sampling station: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「二級處理出水採樣站」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at secondary-effluent sampling station.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「二級處理出水採樣站」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for secondary-effluent sampling station; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.objective: 完成 工業回用需求端：回用水混合與需求配對 的量測或模型練習，記錄與假設的差異。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete the measurement/model exercise for Industrial reuse demand: Reuse blending and demand matching and record deviations from assumptions.
steps.instruction:
檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「工業回用需求端」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
操作任務：先點選「工業回用需求端」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
steps.instructionEn:
Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for industrial reuse demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Action: Select the industrial reuse demand measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：Q1=80、Q2=20 m³/h；C1=5、C2=100 mg/L。公式 Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)；代入 (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L。適用邊界：同一可加成保守溶質；微生物風險與化學相容性不能僅靠此式判斷。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: Q1=80 and Q2=20 m³/h; C1=5 and C2=100 mg/L. Formula Cmix=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2); substitution (80*5+20*100)/(80+20) = 24 mg/L. Boundary: One additive conservative solute; microbial risk and chemical compatibility cannot be established by this formula.
steps.failure: 混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

title: 新加坡新生水系統
summary: 以新生水為觀察案例，學徒扮演水質工程師，沿進水、膜列、消毒、儲水與需求端追蹤水和污染物。
summaryEn: Using NEWater as the reference, the learner acts as a water-quality engineer following water and contaminants through feed, membrane trains, disinfection, storage and demand.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

workedExample.title: 教學算例
workedExample.text: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
workedExample.textEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
